Copia,
Durchlauchtigster Fürst!
gnädigster Fürst und Herr!
Euer Hochfürstliche Durchlaucht ermangle ich nicht
untertänigst anzuzeigen, daß Sr Majestät auf den
Vortrag Höchstdero Schreibens vom 21ten d. M.
zu befehlen geruhet haben, daß die Beantwor¬
tung desselben, wie Euer Hochfürstliche Durchlaucht
selbst zu erwarten schienen, biß zur Einkunfft des von
dem Etats Minister v. Voss erforderten Berichts aus¬
Ich verharre mit der
gesetzt bleiben solle.
tiefsten Ehrerbietung
Euer Hochfürstlichen Durchlaucht
Berlin
den 25ten Januar 1799.
(ad 1. Febr 1799)
untertänigster diener
Beyme

translation.en: Copy. Most Serene Prince! Most gracious Prince and Lord! I do not fail to report most humbly to Your Most Serene Highness that His Majesty, upon the presentation of Your Most Serene Highness's letter of the 21st of this month, has been graciously pleased to command that the answering of the same, as Your Most Serene Highness yourself appeared to expect, shall remain deferred until the arrival of the report required from the Minister of State von Voss. I persist with the deepest reverence Your Most Serene Highness's Berlin, the 25th of January 1799. (ad 1 February 1799) most humble and obedient servant Beyme

text_english: Copy. Most Serene Prince! Most gracious Prince and Lord! I do not fail to report most humbly to Your Most Serene Highness that His Majesty, upon the presentation of Your Most Serene Highness's letter of the 21st of this month, has been graciously pleased to command that the answering of the same, as Your Most Serene Highness yourself appeared to expect, shall remain deferred until the arrival of the report required from the Minister of State von Voss. I persist with the deepest reverence Your Most Serene Highness's Berlin, the 25th of January 1799. (ad 1 February 1799) most humble and obedient servant Beyme
summary_en: Copy of a reply from Beyme in Berlin: the King, having been shown the Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen's letter of the 21st of the month, has ordered that any answer be deferred, as the Prince himself seemed to anticipate, until the report demanded from Minister of State von Voss has arrived. Formal expressions of humble service close the note, which is marked as received on 1 February 1799.
summary_de: Abschrift einer Antwort des Kabinettsrats Beyme: Auf die Vorlegung des fürstlichen Schreibens vom 21. dieses Monats habe Se. Majestät befohlen, die Beantwortung – wie der Fürst selbst erwartet zu haben scheine – bis zum Eingang des vom Staatsminister v. Voss eingeforderten Berichts auszusetzen. Beigefügt der Präsentationsvermerk "ad 1. Febr 1799". Sonst kein sachlicher Inhalt.
